item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02580","case1_error":"Reverses Ida’s comparison, writing I = J − 30 instead of J + 30, then substitutes unsupported dress prices.","case2_error":"Omits the $150 fixed rental charge, reporting only mileage costs.","reason":"The first reverses a stated relationship and invents replacement values; the second omits a required cost component.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02581","case1_error":"Treats the 12-apple difference as the green-apple count, adding 16 + 12 for the total.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 20 − (2 + 4 + 1 + 4) as 11 instead of 9.","reason":"The first confuses a difference with a category count; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02582","case1_error":"Uses an incorrect conversion factor of 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Calculates reading speed using the old daily page count divided by the new reading time.","reason":"The first uses a false unit conversion; the second combines quantities from different conditions to infer an incorrect rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02583","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 600, but the derivation and concluding answer correctly give 400 dog legs.","case2_error":"Reports the $5,550 returned-book value as retained sales, falsely equating total sales with returns and omitting subtraction.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02584","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 48 − 17 − 10 as 11 instead of 21, understating remaining sales and profit.","case2_error":"Omits the additional 20% bulk discount, reporting only the $75 savings from the sale price.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correctly written subtraction; the second leaves out a required discount.","judgment":"different"}]}
